activity.notes: Elizabeth Petrovna, daughter of Peter the Great, became Empress of Russia after the palace coup of 1741 and reigned until her death in early 1762 by New Style dating. Russian Museum materials give the reign as 25 November/6 December 1741 to 25 December 1761/5 January 1762. ATLAS records the sovereign Activity at year granularity as 1741–1762 to avoid mixing Old Style and New Style day-level dates in one interval.
